answer: Forging N identities costs N bonds plus compute, scaling linearly against attackers. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to claimed reputation, verified through a proof-of-work trellis linking identity to historical contributions. A challenge-response bridge periodically samples cross-epoch activity, while a canyon of revoked keys isolates proven sybils, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
